snippet_primary: "How does this stack up to other platforms? It's pretty comparable: eBay's fees are often 12–15%, Amazon Handmade is about 15%, and Shopify's structure is different (monthly fee plus transaction fees). Etsy's big advantage: no monthly store fee, so it's low-risk to start. But sellers do have to keep an eye on rising fees and competition—especially as Etsy's take rate keeps inching up."
